plan.title: Reject Non-Numeric Quantity in Recreate Order

steps.note: Open the existing awarded event's summary page.
Ensure the required eRFX project configuration is enabled for the case.
Open the RFQ stage Settings menu and launch the Recreate Order window.

args.goal: In the Recreate Order window, click Edit More Details, enter abc in the Quantity Requested* field, click Create Order, and stop when the application visibly rejects the non-numeric quantity.

steps.note: Perform the dialog-specific interaction and capture the application's rejection.
Assert that the application refused the Create Order submission.
